verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair axis for a SaaS point-of-sale platform, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for Shopify POS events. The closest items don't qualify: Shopify Flow-powered low-stock notifications are an adjacent feature, and POS UI extensions querying the GraphQL Admin API via fetch() are developer building blocks, not event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
